one_line_contribution: A pre-registered ALFWorld measurement of what fraction of a procedural-memory bank's task-type-specific value is already held by a GEPA-optimized instruction built from the same episodes, identified by crossing instruction provenance with bank provenance (the task-type provenance square) and reported as a scale-free absorbed share A = 1 - Inner(I_own)/Inner(I_oth) with a treatment-free null replicate of the ratio itself.
closest_prior_work: The proposal names EvoAgentBench (arXiv 2607.05202) itself and concedes it publishes the qualitative headline: ReasoningBank (+3.6) and GEPA (+1.2) on the same 528/267 trajectories on Qwen3.5-27B. That concession is correct and it is the paper that caps this contribution. But the threat I can actually verify from my own knowledge is the pair MIPROv2 (arXiv 2406.11695) plus ExpeL (arXiv 2308.10144). MIPROv2 already factorizes a prompt into instructions and bootstrapped demonstrations, optimizes each alone on one training set, and reports that the split is task-dependent -- that is the two-container substitution ablation, on the same episodes, with a published answer. ExpeL already distills training episodes into an insights block and prepends it, so the memory bank in the closest target system IS an instruction; the proposal states this in its own first paragraph. Given those two, what is left is (a) provenance labelling of both containers, (b) the episode-disjoint same-type instruction I'(T,r), (c) the ratio endpoint, (d) the item-overlap dose-response, and (e) the ALFWorld setting where the effect is 5-15pt rather than 0.6-3.6pt. That residue is a real but modest delta over MIPROv2-with-retrieval, and the proposal's own framing (identification-and-quantification, not a new phenomenon) is an accurate self-assessment rather than false modesty.
strongest_objection: The confirmatory endpoint's denominator is not a neutral reference, and the bracket does not bracket the resulting bias. Inner(I_oth) is measured at an instruction that was optimized on the OTHER type set's episodes and is then applied to own-type test games. I_oth is not merely a lower-accuracy instruction; it is a mis-specified one -- an instruction tuned to locate-carry-to-appliance-operate procedure being run on fetch-and-place games (and vice versa) will actively push wrong procedure. B_own then repairs that damage, and the repair is scored as relevance advantage in the denominator, inflating A toward the 0.5 threshold. Nothing in the plan corrects this channel. A_h = (l_own - l_oth)/(1 - l_oth) is a scalar level correction under a multiplicative headroom model, and mis-specification is precisely a shape effect, not a level effect: the deficit concentrates on exactly the games where on-type memory helps, which is the one place a uniform-compression model cannot reach. And the over-correcting end of the bracket, Ladder T, only ever produces same-type instructions I'(T,r) from the disjoint pool P'_train, so it titrates level while never instantiating wrong-type procedure -- the bracket is silent on the very channel that most inflates A. The result is that the headline 'the instruction already contains the bank' is observationally confounded with 'a wrong-type instruction is a handicap that an on-type bank removes', which would be a statement about instruction mis-specification, not about container substitution. Row 1 already measures Inner(I0*), so the cleaner denominator exists in the grid and is deliberately not used. A second, internal edge of the same problem: G3 demands Inner(I0*) >= 9pt while G1 fixes help(I0*) >= 5pt, so passing G3 with adequate power essentially requires the off-type bank to HARM by several points relative to no memory -- exactly what the proposal's own cited ALFWorld literature on retrieval pollution (2604.27003, 2608.15008) predicts. But a large off-type harm term is what drives ChangeInner through the off component, and Rule M then routes the reading to distractor-robustness rather than absorption. The design's power requirement and its mechanism rule pull in opposite directions: the most likely path to a powered study is also the most likely path to a non-confirmatory one.
what_would_fix_it: (1) Make A against Inner(I0*) a co-primary endpoint rather than a row-1 side quantity, and pre-register the diagnostic that separates absorption from repair-of-mis-specification: report, at item granularity, whether B_own at I_oth fixes games that I0* already solves. If the on-type bank at I_oth is mostly recovering games I0* gets right, the denominator is measuring instruction damage and A is not an absorbed share. Also pre-register a check that Inner(I_oth) is not materially larger than Inner(I0*), and declare the primary uninterpretable if it is. (2) Promote I_type and a provenance-labelled compiled block (C_own vs C_oth) into the Tier-0 square. The proposal's own most-likely branch is A_epi ~ 0 with A_type >= 0.4, and that branch is uninterpretable without I_type, which currently sits in Tier 1 inside the cut list. (3) Fix the partition rationale or the partition. T_A = {pick_and_place, pick_two, look_in_light} is justified as 'fetch-and-place, no object state change', but look_at_obj_in_light requires finding and toggling a desklamp -- a device operation, which is the stated defining feature of T_B. Either justify the split on the measured retrieval-overlap criterion alone and drop the procedural story, or move look_in_light and re-derive the counts (T_B's reserve of ~116 games is already the binding constraint). (4) Buy back the third optimizer seed by cutting rows 13 and 15. With two seeds the crossed random effect for optimizer run in the mixed-effects model is not estimable, the cluster bootstrap over optimizer runs resamples two clusters, and the quoted 0.8pt-per-run variance component is transferred wholesale from E1 multi-hop QA and cannot be checked in ALFWorld. (5) Run pre-freeze obligation (1) -- the data-provenance-crossover search in the contamination and data-attribution literatures -- before submission and report it, not as a conditional promise; the only unshared claim in the proposal is conditional on a search that has never been run. (6) Move the official valid_seen / valid_unseen cells out of Tier 1: the 5-15pt literature prior that G1 is benchmarked against was measured on those splits, not on 1,200 held-out training games.
missing_baseline: A provenance-labelled static instruction produced by distillation WITHOUT the optimizer, run inside the square. The plan has C_all only in the pooled practitioner row 11 and C_own only at Tier 1, so no Tier-0 cell answers whether the absorbed share requires a reflective optimizer at all or is simply what happens when the same episodes are written into prose. Given the proposal's own concession that ExpeL's insight block is already an instruction, {C_own, C_oth} x {B_own, B_oth} is the arm a reviewer will demand, and its absence means the paper cannot distinguish 'GEPA absorbed the bank' from 'any prose summary of these episodes absorbs the bank', which is a materially weaker and already-published claim. Two further omissions from Tier 0 that reviewers will name: I_type (what the three task-type LABELS alone buy, with no episodes) -- decisive for the pre-registered A_epi ~ 0 / A_type large branch yet currently droppable; and the whole-bank long-context dump M_all / R_raw, which the proposal itself motivates by citing EvoMemBench (2605.18421) finding long-context baselines competitive against fifteen memory methods, then relegates to a cuttable tier.
preprint_collision: The check is unusually strong by proposal standards -- a dated scan (2026-09-03), 15 HuggingFace queries over 244 papers, by-id abstract verification for 54 arXiv IDs, the closest competitor's PDF read in full with its extracted text committed under SHA256, and a corrected error (ReasoningBank's Qwen gain is +3.6, not the +7 a web snippet reported). It also concedes rather than hides the collision: EvoAgentBench (2607.05202) already publishes the qualitative headline, and ExpeL (2308.10144) already makes memory-as-instruction a design pattern. That honesty is worth credit and I take the concession at face value. Three problems remain, and they are not neutral. First, the single search that bears on the proposal's only unshared claim -- held-out-episode and data-provenance crossovers in the prompt-optimization, contamination and data-attribution literatures -- has never been run from this node and is deferred to a pre-freeze obligation. The proposal states the contribution reduces to the ALFWorld measurement if that search lands. A novelty claim conditional on an unrun search is an unestablished novelty claim, and it happens to be the exact primitive most likely to already exist: leave-a-subset-out attribution of a learned artifact's benefit to the data that produced it is a standard move, and I would expect at least a prompt-optimization variant of it to exist by now. Second, arXiv is unreachable from the node, so every 2026 ID rests on a single web-search channel, and the plan admits that 'confirmed absent from the paper' is asserted from abstracts for every competitor except EvoAgentBench. The one snippet they could cross-check was already wrong, which is direct evidence that the channel is unreliable, and the entire Related Work section's positioning depends on it. I cannot verify any of the post-May-2026 IDs myself; the pre-cutoff ones (2308.10144, 2406.11695, 2502.12110, 2507.19457, 2508.06433, 2509.25140) do check out. Third, obligation (2) names an unopened appendix -- arXiv 2608.14036 -- as a live collision for prediction 6 (compile-once beats live retrieval at matched tokens). That is a known, specific, unresolved collision on a headline prediction, flagged but not cleared. Net: not an unsearched claim of novelty, but a searched claim whose one load-bearing search is outstanding and whose verification channel has a demonstrated error rate.
